title: YOUR PLATE CLANGS AND BREAKS
why: His order of 2026-10-12: improve the sound and give actions a distinct noise. A hit on you made the same old blip whether your armour plate took it or it went into you, the same blip every other hit in the game makes, so nothing told you your armour was working or that it was gone. Now a hit on the plate rings with a short bright clang, a hit that gets through is a dull thump, and a hit that does both plays both, lighter. The moment your plate runs out it breaks with a glassy shatter and a low knock, once, like a shield breaking in Fortnite. Sound only: nothing in the raid changes.
now: A hit on your plate now clangs, a hit that gets through thumps, and the plate shatters when it breaks.
